The '''1929–30''' [[La Liga|Primera División]] season started 1 December 1929, and finished 30 March 1930. A total of 10 teams contested the league, where [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] were the defending champions. As different from the previous season, the last qualified team was directly relegated.

[[Athletic Bilbao]] achieved their first title ever after ending the season unbeaten.
